title: Meal plan recipe path helper
description: Add a focused helper for deriving the `./<relative-without-extension>` recipe reference path from a recipe file URL and configured recipes folder.
acceptance_criteria: A helper exists in the meal-plan app layer to convert recipe file URLs into `./<relative>` paths without the `.cook` extension.
The helper handles nested recipe folders and root-level recipes.
The helper API is small enough to be reused by the add-to-meal-plan service without duplicating path math.

handoff_summary.completed: MealPlanRecipePath enum implemented with `path(for:relativeTo:)`, `recipeURL(for:in:)`, and `displayName(for:)`. All three acceptance criteria satisfied: URL→path conversion, nested and root-level recipe support, small reusable API.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads should wire callers in MealPlanDetailView and the add-to-meal-plan service to use these helpers instead of duplicating the path-cleanup logic inline.
handoff_summary.risks: No runtime risks. The `.path` property on security-scoped bookmark URLs returns the standard filesystem path; prefix matching is stable. The `.cook` extension strip is case-insensitive via `.lowercased().hasSuffix`.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should add unit tests for all three helpers: URL→path for nested and root-level recipes, nil return when URL is outside the folder, path→URL round-trip, and display-name extraction.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. New file only; no existing files were modified.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used an `enum` with no cases as a namespace (cannot be instantiated, same pattern as other helpers in the codebase). Kept `.path` rather than `.standardizedFileURL.path` to avoid symlink resolution surprises with security-scoped bookmark URLs. Extension stripping done with lowercased string suffix check to avoid URL(fileURLWithPath:) CWD-resolution side-effects on relative paths.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (tester bead responsibility). Key cases to cover: nested path, root-level path, URL outside folder (nil return), path with no `./` prefix in `recipeURL(for:in:)`, display name with nested path.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The helper does not access the filesystem — it does pure string/URL path math. Callers must bracket security-scoped resource access themselves when they subsequently use the returned URLs for I/O.

conflict_risks: None. New file only; no existing files were modified.

execution_history.summary: Created `CookbookApp/MealPlans/MealPlanRecipePath.swift` — an enum namespace with three static helpers for translating between absolute recipe `URL`s and the `./relative-without-extension` strings used in `.menu` files. Covers URL→path conversion, path→URL resolution, and display-name extraction. Syntax-checked clean with `swiftc -typecheck`.
